headline: India to resume tourist visas for Bangladeshis from June 28
summary: The Indian High Commissioner announced that visitor visa processing will restart after a nearly two-year hiatus.
details: India is set to resume processing tourist visas for Bangladeshi citizens starting Sunday, June 28.
The announcement was made by the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, who confirmed the resumption of visitor visa services.
This move comes after a nearly two-year period during which tourist visa processing had been suspended.
The resumption of these visas is expected to facilitate easier travel for Bangladeshis visiting India for tourism and leisure purposes.
caption:
Travel to India is opening up again! Tourist visas for Bangladeshis will be processed starting June 28.

India is set to resume processing tourist visas for Bangladeshi citizens starting Sunday, June 28.

The announcement was made by the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, who confirmed the resumption of visitor visa services.

This move comes after a nearly two-year period during which tourist visa processing had been suspended.

The resumption of these visas is expected to facilitate easier travel for Bangladeshis visiting India for tourism and leisure purposes.

headline_marked: PM Tarique meets Chinese Premier Li Qiang in [[Beijing for bilateral talks]]
headline: PM Tarique meets Chinese Premier Li Qiang in Beijing for bilateral talks
summary: The Prime Minister led a high-level delegation to the Great Hall of the People, focusing on expanding manufacturing and investment in Bangladesh.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Chinese Premier Li Qiang at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Thursday. The meeting was part of a high-level bilateral visit to strengthen ties between the two nations.
The Prime Minister was accompanied by a high-profile delegation, including Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman, Information Minister Zahir Uddin Swapon, and advisors for Finance, Education, and Energy.
During the visit, the Prime Minister invited Chinese firms to expand their manufacturing operations within Bangladesh to boost the local economy.
Bangladesh also announced plans to open a new investment office in China to facilitate smoother business operations and attract more Chinese investment.
The visit was marked by high honors, including a red carpet welcome and a gun salute at the Great Hall of the People.
Following the bilateral discussions, Premier Li Qiang hosted a dinner in honor of the Prime Minister and the Bangladeshi delegation.
caption:
Red carpet and gun salutes in Beijing. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman meets Chinese Premier Li Qiang to boost investment.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Chinese Premier Li Qiang at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Thursday. The meeting was part of a high-level bilateral visit to strengthen ties between the two nations.

The Prime Minister was accompanied by a high-profile delegation, including Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman, Information Minister Zahir Uddin Swapon, and advisors for Finance, Education, and Energy.

During the visit, the Prime Minister invited Chinese firms to expand their manufacturing operations within Bangladesh to boost the local economy.

Bangladesh also announced plans to open a new investment office in China to facilitate smoother business operations and attract more Chinese investment.

The visit was marked by high honors, including a red carpet welcome and a gun salute at the Great Hall of the People.

Following the bilateral discussions, Premier Li Qiang hosted a dinner in honor of the Prime Minister and the Bangladeshi delegation.

#Bangladesh #China #Diplomacy #Investment #Beijing #TariqueRahman
